_comment: Lip mucosa for skin type III (Phase08 8.2, RD-P08-3): paired with Skin_FitzpatrickIII_Clean_Base_s001_v01 by the shared Variant token. SUBSURFACE, as skin, but redder, smoother and moist. Derived from the skin by one rule (sources).
name: Lips_FitzpatrickIII_Clean_Base_s001_v01

sources.why: Phase08 8.2 derivation rule (judgement; no measured lip albedo exists, F-P08-1): lips = the skin's albedo x (0.80, 0.55, 0.60), i.e. the skin's own melanin with blood showing through a thinner stratum corneum (red kept, green and blue drop). On Skin III this gives (0.50, 0.24, 0.21), the shipped Lips_Natural (0.52, 0.26, 0.24) within 0.03. Every other value is Lips_Natural's (roughness 0.35 and coat 0.3 at 0.2, IOR 1.336: MPFB2's lips and a film of saliva); the scatter radius and its per-channel scale are the skin's own (Physically Based). Inputs: Skin_FitzpatrickIII_Clean_Base_s001_v01 base_color_const (0.623, 0.433, 0.343).
